title: 12 Best Edinburgh Whisky Bars
description: Explore Edinburgh's top 12 whisky bars for 2026. From historic pubs to exclusive tasting rooms, discover where to find the finest drams, flights, and food pairings in Scotland's capital. Includes local tips and prices.

places.name: Whiski Rooms
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A regional whisky flight (e.g., Islay or Speyside) paired with their Cullen Skink.

places.name: The Scotch Malt Whisky Society (SMWS) - Kaleidoscope Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the bar staff for a recommendation from their 'flavour profile' menu – try something you've never had before.

places.name: Amber Restaurant & Whisky Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Whisky Journey' flight, which guides you through different regions of Scotland, accompanied by their Scottish sharing platter.

places.name: The Devil's Advocate
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Old Fashioned made with a quality Scotch, or one of their house recommendations from their whisky list.

places.name: Usquabae Whisky Bar & Larder
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their themed whisky flights, focusing on a region or distillery style, complemented by their Haggis, Neeps, and Tatties.

places.name: The Bow Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A dram of a lesser-known independent bottling or a classic Ardbeg, alongside a pint of local real ale.

places.name: Jeffrey Street Whisky and Tobacco
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for a tasting of a particular region you're interested in, or challenge the staff to introduce you to something entirely new and unique.

places.name: The Albanach
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Speyside single malt, like a Macallan or Glenfiddich, to enjoy the quintessential Scottish experience.

places.name: The Ensign Ewart
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A peated Islay whisky, like a Laphroaig or Lagavulin, fitting the historic and robust atmosphere.

places.name: Cask Smugglers
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their whisky highballs for a refreshing twist, or a lesser-known Highland single malt.

places.name: Teuchters Landing
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A dram of a coastal malt like Old Pulteney or a Highland Park, complementing the waterside setting.

places.name: The Black Cat
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the staff for their current favourite independent bottling or a lesser-known lowland single grain whisky.
